notes: beli mayim 'without water' → 'where no water is': the privative takes the relative and copula as its clausal recasting, headed on the negation (rules 48, 50); competing reading with 'where' added under rule 55 is named in the unit note.
Piel shachar → 'earnestly will I seek' keeps earnestly inside the verb's own lexeme; no adverb is supplied.
